sqlite.statement: SELECT id, email, name, created FROM customers ORDER BY id

capabilities.output: List<Record {id: Int, email: String, name: String, created: Int}>

sqlite.statement: UPDATE customers SET email = :email WHERE id = :id

capabilities.description: Sets the stored email of a customer.
Deletes a customer that no order or note points at.

sqlite.statement: UPDATE orders SET customer_id = :to_id WHERE customer_id = :from_id

capabilities.description: Moves every order of one customer to another and returns how many moved.

sqlite.statement: SELECT id, body FROM notes WHERE customer_id = :customer_id ORDER BY id

capabilities.description: Lists the notes about one customer.

sqlite.statement: UPDATE notes SET customer_id = :to_id WHERE id = :id

capabilities.description: Moves one note to another customer. Fails with a conflict when that customer has a note with the same body.
